capabilities: Hide \begin{code} and \end{code} markers in .haskell blocks in .lhs files
disambiguation: Not Haskell syntax highlighting or an execution environment; it only makes .lhs files render like Markdown and hides the code markers.
motivation: The author sees literate Haskell as a good way to include runnable Haskell code in Obsidian, but the required code markers would litter the code blocks.
problem: Haskell's .lhs files contain runnable code wrapped in LaTeX markers that Obsidian would otherwise render as literal clutter in code blocks and not treat as notes.
summary: Literate Haskell support that treats .lhs files like Markdown notes and hides the \begin{code}/\end{code} markers around Haskell blocks.
